Thanks for updating the screenshots! The "Before" looks like the image from the issue, and it's cropped differently than the "After". Could you take both from your own build, showing the same message with the same crop, as described in [the guide on precise before/after screenshots](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html#what-are-precise-before-after-screenshots)?
